USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Channel rather than G-protein signaling

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

Researchers apply serotonin to a cultured vagal sensory neuron and record an immediate cation current. Ondansetron abolishes that current, whereas a muscarinic antagonist has no effect. Which receptor structure best accounts for the blocked response?

  1. Gs-coupled seven-transmembrane receptor
  2. Gi-coupled seven-transmembrane receptor
  3. Intracellular nuclear receptor
  4. Receptor tyrosine kinase
  5. Ligand-gated ion channel
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Ligand-gated ion channel

The 5-HT3 receptor is an ionotropic serotonin receptor, unlike most other serotonin receptor subtypes.

Understanding the options

Ligand-gated ion channel
The 5-HT3 receptor is an ionotropic serotonin receptor, unlike most other serotonin receptor subtypes.
Gs-coupled seven-transmembrane receptor
Gs signaling is typical of several other serotonin receptors, not 5-HT3.
Gi-coupled seven-transmembrane receptor
Gi coupling characterizes 5-HT1 receptors.
Intracellular nuclear receptor
An immediate membrane current is not nuclear receptor signaling.
Receptor tyrosine kinase
5-HT3 lacks intrinsic tyrosine kinase signaling.
